keyPhrases.text: not a spicy knock out — at least not yet
bloated dish, with too much repetition
It gets better as the show continues

reasoning: Mixed review with balanced positive and negative elements. Acknowledges potential ('not completely ready yet') and highlights good songs, performances, and production elements, but criticizes bloated structure, poor lyrics, and distracting staging. The gazpacho metaphor suggests work-in-progress rather than outright failure.
